content: In all the games the maximum number of steps has been set to 50. As mentioned earlier, the cell representation used in the Go-Explore archive is computed by the sum of embeddings of the room description tokens concatenated with the current cumulative reward. The sum of embeddings is computed using 50 dimensional pre-trained GloVe BIBREF36 vectors. In the CoinCollector baselines we use the same hyper-parameters as in the original paper. In CookingWorld all the baselines use pre-trained GloVe of dimension 100 for the single setting and 300 for the joint one. The LSTM hidden state has been set to 300 for all the models.
